sglang_election.conclusion: Select FP8 DSpark for the measured balanced multi-load/context score; not a universal replacement. Tony's published recipe (tv-std) wins c1 and 32k decode; SGLang wins the other six throughput points. Candidate and the published community recipe both fail the strict all-observation retrieval gate. The elected 0.80 setup also passed the single fresh-JIT cold start; this does not qualify plain mode cold startup.

humaneval_attribution.interpretation: [INFERENCE] Both execution stack and FP8-attention path contribute to the observed gap. Original-checkpoint SGLang already scores 3 fewer passes and 3 more truncations than the published community recipe; FP8 then scores 2 fewer passes and 2 more truncations than original-checkpoint SGLang on the same host/settings. The entire 5-pass gap cannot be assigned to FP8. This is a single greedy cohort, not statistical proof or a causal percentage split; the published recipe comparison also retains its earlier machine/runtime assignment.
